titles.title: That's How I Became a Villainess

description:
Her husband was having an affair with her closest friend. A woman who was once her only confidante, now carrying her husband’s child.

Yet Bridgette showed no anger toward her husband, nor toward his mistress.

“Congratulations on your pregnancy, Penelope. Tell me—is the child you carry my husband’s?”

—

Julian—the former lover she had loved to the point of torment, yet was forced to leave for reasons left unspoken.

“Now that you have dared show yourself before me, I have no choice but to kill you, traitor that you are.”

He had no intention of ever forgiving her. And saving him was another duty bound to this lifetime.

In this second life granted to Bridgette, she intends to do everything she failed to accomplish before.

Even if the entire world brands her a villainess.
